attchmntText: Uma Exports Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Uma Exports Limited announced the Board approved Unaudited Standalone Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The Board meeting was held on November 14, 2026. For the quarter ended September 30, 2026, revenue from operations was Rs. 32,087.72 lakhs. Net profit after tax was Rs. 81.85 lakhs. Earnings per share was Rs. 0.24. For the half year ended September 30, 2026, revenue from operations was Rs. 51,421.20 lakhs. Net profit after tax was Rs. 144.63 lakhs. Earnings per share was Rs. 0.43. The Statutory Auditors, Mamta Jain and Associates, issued an unmodified conclusion on the review of these results. The financials are available on the company website and stock exchange portals.
